usage: Use 回覆 for a written or spoken reply, especially in emails, messages, or formal business communication.
As a verb, it is more formal than simple everyday options; it sounds neat and professional in office settings.
It often appears with time words or polite request phrases when asking someone to answer promptly.
In business contexts, it is commonly used for responses to enquiries, requests, quotations, or documents.
